races.name: Ladies Day 9th May "Confined" Novice Stakes (No more than two runs) (GBB/GBBPlus Race) (Div I)

runners_data.name: Tripoli Flyer
runners_data.note: Hold-up type switching from jumps to Flat after 47 days off, needs strong pace to aim at
runners_data.comment: Smart bumper/novice hurdle form; well held behind Constitution Hill on Flat debut
runners_data.spotlight: Smart bumper/novice hurdle form; recorded an RPR of 141 when eighth in the County Hurdle four weeks ago; no match for Constitution Hill on his Flat debut but he should do better in this sphere at some point, probably when handicapping.

runners_data.name: Mr Bollinger
runners_data.note: Lightly raced unknown quantity for in-form Michael Bell yard, going preferences unclear

runners_data.name: Director's Cut
runners_data.note: Prominent runner likely to lead after 132-day break, stamina advantage at this trip
runners_data.comment: 1m AW win on second 2yo start; new trip should suit but he has a penalty to shoulder
runners_data.spotlight: Two runs in November, fifth on debut (8.6f) before putting that experience to good use at Newcastle 19 days later where he finished strongest to beat 11 rivals (1m); new trip should suit and he is bred to carry on improving; the penalty does ask a stiffer question though.

runners_data.name: Hatteen
runners_data.note: Showed promise second time out, prominent style could track the leader early
runners_data.comment: Only beat one rival in two 2yo runs but the 2nd effort was encouraging; longer trip a plus
runners_data.spotlight: Last of three on debut (1m, soft) and fifth of six on his second 2yo run (8.3f, good to soft); the latter effort wasn't without promise, however, and this longer trip should be right up his street.

runners_data.name: Infraad
runners_data.note: Highest-rated runner with hold-up style, 166 days since last run but class edge evident
runners_data.comment: Green but made a pleasing debut at Doncaster in October (1m, soft); likely big improver
runners_data.spotlight: In need of the experience when second of five in a 1m maiden at Doncaster (soft) last October; flattered by his proximity to the idling winner but it was still an encouraging start and today's extra yardage looks a big positive; leading contender.

runners_data.name: Grazeon Sunshine
runners_data.note: Hold-up veteran back quickly after 35 days, longest absence may benefit

runners_data.name: Bay Royale
runners_data.note: Hold-up type returning after 161 days, needs strong gallop to be effective

runners_data.name: You Got To My Soul
runners_data.note: Consistent hold-up horse back after 39 days with useful recent form

runners_data.name: That Darn Cantor
runners_data.note: Lowest-rated hold-up runner returning after 168-day absence, needs everything to fall right

races.paceDynamic: Director's Cut emerges as the clear pace-setter with his prominent style and recent front-running form, likely to dictate terms from the outset with sustainable fractions over this staying trip. Hatteen may also show early speed to track closely, but the majority of this field are hold-up horses including Tripoli Flyer, Infraad, You Got To My Soul, Bay Royale, Grazeon Sunshine and That Darn Cantor. With limited early pace pressure beyond Director's Cut, this sets up perfectly for the patient hold-up types who can finish strongly. This race shape strongly favours the hold-up brigade who can exploit what should be a moderate gallop and unleash their finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Director's Cut sets uncontested fractions allowing closers to pounce
scenarios.body: The lone leader gets swamped in the final furlong as multiple hold-up horses unleash simultaneous finishing kicks. Infraad and You Got To My Soul benefit most from their class and tactical positioning.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Steals It
scenarios.trigger: If Director's Cut gets easy splits and kicks clear turning for home
scenarios.body: The Gosden runner exploits the soft pace to build an unassailable lead, holding off late challenges. His stamina and racecourse nous prove decisive against inexperienced closers.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Messy Pace Helps Outsider
scenarios.trigger: If early scrimmaging between Director's Cut and Hatteen creates stop-start fractions
scenarios.body: The uneven tempo suits a patient ride on Grazeon Sunshine or Bay Royale who can pick up the pieces. Chaos favours the unfancied runners with less pressure and lower expectations.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Infraad Class Tells Late
scenarios.trigger: If the Haggas runner gets the perfect stalking position behind moderate pace
scenarios.body: Superior ability shines through as Infraad quickens decisively in the final two furlongs. His class edge over this novice field becomes apparent when it matters most.

watchPoints.text: Director's Cut must be monitored early - if he gets loose on the lead with soft fractions, he becomes very dangerous
Watch for any early pace battle between Director's Cut and Hatteen which could set up the race for closers
Infraad's market support will be telling given his class advantage but long absence
Keep an eye on Mr Bollinger's positioning as the unknown quantity from the Bell stable
Monitor how Tripoli Flyer handles the switch back to Flat racing after recent hurdles campaign

races.name: Ladies Day 9th May "Confined" Novice Stakes (No more than two runs) (GBB/GBBPlus Race) (Div II)

runners_data.name: Olympic Charter
runners_data.comment: Has a smart pedigree and yard is 3-7 in novice events this year; striking debutant
runners_data.spotlight: Fifth foal; closely related to 5f AW winner Nordic Games (RPR 73), half-brother to three winners including Beautiful Love (1m/1m3f including US Grade 3; 115) and Flying Honours (7f-1m2f 2yo including Group 3; 108); dam 1m1f-11.5f winner (including Group 3; 105); yard 3-7 in novice events this year and he's respected on debut.

runners_data.name: Qarreeb
runners_data.comment: Made a low-key start at Wolverhampton in November and he needs a transformation on return
runners_data.spotlight: Half-brother to two useful winners but he made a low-key start when seventh of ten at Wolverhampton (8.6f) in November; should know more this time but he needs a transformation upped in trip on his return.

races.name: Flat Is Back Restricted Novice Stakes (For horses in Bands B, C and D) (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)

runners_data.name: Invincible Isaac
runners_data.comment: Lost all chance at the start in the Brocklesby but clear promise mid-race; can do better
runners_data.spotlight: 66-1 and beaten over 15l in the Brocklesby on debut, but he lost all chance when completely blowing the start; showed clear promise with that in mind and he shouldn't be underestimated here if breaking cleanly.

races.name: Four Legged Friend 26th April Handicap

runners_data.name: J Street
runners_data.note: Prominent racer suited by the likely tactical setup but trainer Easterby is 0/17 over the past fortnight and form figures are modest.
runners_data.comment: Shaped nicely at Doncaster ten days ago; still capable of better; interesting contender
runners_data.spotlight: Just one win from 12 starts but she ended her time with Ivan Furtado with a good second at Wolverhampton in October (third past the post) and both runs for her current stable have threatened better; should get a good pace to aim at here and she is an interesting contender.

runners_data.name: Bang On The Bell
runners_data.note: Experienced prominent runner who should get an ideal trip tracking Fiorella Princess but aging performer with limited recent winning form.

runners_data.name: Over Spiced
runners_data.note: Strong prominent profile with excellent course record and returning from a break which often suits Grace Harris runners.

runners_data.name: Albegone
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who needs gaps late and has proven turf form on good ground, but wide draw complicates his task.
runners_data.comment: Return to turf in his favour and he lurks on a dangerous mark; one for the shortlist
runners_data.spotlight: Multiple turf winner on good ground or slower; fit from AW, where he has run well in two of his three runs this year; should be in the thick of it.

runners_data.name: Glory Fighter
runners_data.note: Seasoned prominent runner with course and distance experience who should be suited by the likely honest pace.
runners_data.comment: C&D winner; close third on AW when last seen in February; high on the list
runners_data.spotlight: Ten-time turf winner, including C&D; close third at Newcastle when last seen in February; one to consider.

runners_data.name: Komorkis
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning from a long absence who needs everything to fall right from his position at the back of the field.

runners_data.name: Spendmore Lane
runners_data.note: Recent AW winner who has overcome slow starts but must prove the form translates to turf under different tactical conditions.
runners_data.comment: Back-to-back AW wins this year; slow start a hindrance in hat-trick bid latest; turf query
runners_data.spotlight: The starts have been an issue for her but she finally got her act together when winning a 5f handicap at Chelmsford in February; followed up at Wolverhampton soon afterwards but she blew the start in her hat-trick bid at Chelmsford five days later; has a bit more to prove on turf but she can't be discounted.

runners_data.name: Fiorella Princess
runners_data.note: Natural front runner with Hollie Doyle aboard who gets the tactical advantage of dictating terms from the outset.

races.paceDynamic: Fiorella Princess will dictate from the front as the only confirmed leader, likely facing minimal early pressure with most others happy to sit prominent or midfield. Bang On The Bell, Over Spiced, J Street and Glory Fighter should settle just behind in the prominent positions, creating a steady but not searching tempo over 5f. The hold-up horses Albegone, Komorkis and Spendmore Lane will need the pace to collapse or find gaps late. This sustainable pace scenario clearly favours prominent racers who can track the leader and strike when she weakens, rather than front-runners under pressure or hold-up horses needing a strong gallop.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Trackers Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Fiorella Princess sets reasonable fractions and the prominent pack stays within striking distance.
scenarios.body: The pace will be honest but not destructive, allowing the prominent horses to mount their challenges from ideal positions turning for home. This tactical setup perfectly suits horses who can travel strongly behind the leader and quicken when required.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Fiorella Princess gets easy lead and kicks clear turning for home before the prominent horses can respond.
scenarios.body: Her sustainable tempo allows her to save energy for a telling burst, while the prominent horses find themselves with too much ground to make up in the closing stages. The lack of early pace pressure becomes her winning advantage.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Heroes Benefit
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes pedestrian and the race turns into a cavalry charge from the back.
scenarios.body: The modest tempo allows the hold-up horses to overcome their wide draws and poor positions, with Albegone and Spendmore Lane finding the gaps they need late. Fresh legs triumph over better positioned but pace-exposed rivals.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If Fiorella Princess goes too fast early or the prominent horses press her harder than expected.
scenarios.body: The unsustainable tempo leaves the front division vulnerable to anything finishing with a wet sail, creating opportunities for longer-priced outsiders to pick up the pieces. Late-running horses who avoided the early battle profit from others' tactical errors.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Fiorella Princess gets pressed early by Bang On The Bell or Over Spiced, as this could set up the race for hold-up horses.
Monitor Spendmore Lane's starting manners as slow breaks have been problematic and could prove fatal over this minimum trip.
Check if Over Spiced shows any ring rustiness after 170 days off, though Grace Harris runners often return ready first time.
Watch for Albegone getting trapped wide turning for home given his hold-up style and outside draw position.
Observe if Glory Fighter travels kindly given his 10-year-old legs and the need to quicken off what should be a solid pace.

races.name: Family Funday 31st May Handicap

runners_data.name: Glenna
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning from long break but David Probert's 1/7 record for Tom Ward is a concern tactically

runners_data.name: Dryburgh
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with solid recent form but faces traffic problems from the back in a race lacking pace

runners_data.name: Causing Problems
runners_data.note: Another hold-up type who needs luck from the rear, zero wins from four attempts on similar going

runners_data.name: Extraterrestrial
runners_data.note: Classy hold-up horse for in-form Crisford team but must overcome poor draw position and traffic issues

runners_data.name: Port Darwin
runners_data.note: The sole front runner gets a dream scenario to dictate terms with apprentice Callan taking valuable weight off

runners_data.name: Femme Fatale
runners_data.note: Prominent type returning after six months off but James Tate's patient approach suggests readiness

runners_data.name: Al's River
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse facing the usual traffic concerns after 153 days away from track

runners_data.name: Tiny Riot
runners_data.note: Struggling hold-up type whose recent Southwell form has been exposed by subsequent poor performances
runners_data.comment: Modest form from 6f-7f but this son of Sottsass may be a different proposition over 1m2f
runners_data.spotlight: The form of his latest seventh of eight at Southwell (7f) has taken some knocks and he was never the slightest threat in a steadily run affair; did plug on though and he could prove a different proposition now up in trip for his handicap debut; Dan Skelton still seeking a first Flat winner but that is unlikely to remain the case for long and Rossa Ryan has been booked; one to consider.

runners_data.name: Any Which Way
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with noted finishing problems returning after long absence under 7lb claimer

races.paceDynamic: Port Darwin will lead from the start with no other confirmed front runners to pressure him, allowing Jack Callan to dictate a measured gallop through the early stages. Glenna and Femme Fatale will track in behind as the prominent runners, while the large contingent of hold-up horses including Dryburgh, Extraterrestrial, Causing Problems, Al's River, Tiny Riot and Any Which Way will settle towards the rear. With Port Darwin likely uncontested early, he can save energy for the finish, but the weight of numbers behind means the pace will quicken significantly from halfway as multiple closers make their moves. This sustainable early pace followed by a strong finish strongly favours front runners and prominent racers who can avoid the traffic problems that will inevitably affect the back markers.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Holds
scenarios.trigger: If Port Darwin gets soft sectionals and kicks clear turning in
scenarios.body: Port Darwin faces no early pressure and can time his effort perfectly, while the pack behind gets into trouble as multiple hold-up horses vie for racing room. The patient tactics suit the leader who has winning form at the trip.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pair Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Glenna or Femme Fatale get first run on the leader
scenarios.body: The duo tracking Port Darwin can pounce when he comes under pressure, with their prominent positions avoiding the traffic chaos behind. Their higher ratings give them the class edge in a driving finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Weaves Through
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and creates gaps for closers
scenarios.body: Dryburgh or Extraterrestrial find clear passage as the early leaders tire, using their superior class to reel in the front runners. The 1m2f trip allows time for strong finishers to make up ground.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Chaos Finish Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If multiple fallers or interference creates a lottery
scenarios.body: The race becomes a scramble where positioning matters more than ability, allowing an outsider like Causing Problems to sneak through when others are hampered. Jockey skill becomes paramount in the melee.

watchPoints.text: Port Darwin could get uncontested lead and prove very hard to peg back if allowed soft early fractions
Traffic problems inevitable for hold-up horses Dryburgh, Extraterrestrial and Causing Problems turning for home with limited pace up front
Glenna and Femme Fatale both returning from lengthy breaks may need the run despite prominent racing styles
Any Which Way's tendency to fade in the finish could be costly if needing strong kick from rear
Jack Callan's 5lb claim on Port Darwin gives the leader extra tactical advantage in small field

runners_data.name: Revich

runners_data.spotlight: All seven wins have been on good or slower ground on turf; last success was in 2023 but he didn't get much luck when fourth at Wolverhampton (7f) last month and he's in the mix on this step back up in trip.

runners_data.name: Powerful Response

runners_data.name: Antiquity

runners_data.name: Spirit Catcher

runners_data.spotlight: Has done well since joining Rod Millman including two wins on Polytrack (1m) and a creditable second at Lingfield 19 days ago; on same mark as for that last run and is a big player if she can transfer her progress back to turf.

runners_data.name: Gladiadora

runners_data.comment: Back from a break with a win at Southwell 11 days ago and she's a key player back on turf
runners_data.spotlight: Scored at Bath (1m, good to firm) last August and she's added two AW wins since including a brave success in a tight finish at Southwell (7f, Tapeta) 11 days ago; only 2lb higher back on turf and she's strongly respected back up in trip.

runners_data.name: Louie The Legend
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning after 128 days for in-form Dylan Cunha yard with strong recent statistics

runners_data.name: Rogue Officer
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse wearing hood returning after 62 days, has shown best form over shorter trips

runners_data.name: Token Love
runners_data.note: Prominent runner for Greenall/Guerriero partnership returning after 99 days, inconsistent maiden with tongue-tie
runners_data.comment: Inconsistent seven-race maiden and he needs to step up again after 99 days off
runners_data.spotlight: Inconsistent seven-race maiden; raised his game with a close second in Wolverhampton handicap (9.4f) in December, but he faded on his return visit four weeks later; still has potential but he needs to step up again after 99 days off.

runners_data.name: Our Misty Blue
runners_data.note: Natural front-runner with warning that she fades in the finish, will likely set strong early pace

races.paceDynamic: The Sweet Escape and Our Misty Blue will contest the early lead, with both confirmed front-runners likely to ensure an honest gallop from the start. Token Love, Powerful Response, Spirit Catcher and Louie The Legend should sit prominent behind the leaders, while the bulk of the field including Revich, Hostelry, Antiquity and Sir David will need to be ridden for luck from off the pace. The presence of two natural pace-setters should create a genuine tempo that will set up the race for horses with tactical speed who can position handy and kick clear in the straight. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners and those that can travel well just behind the pace rather than hold-up horses who may get caught in traffic in a competitive 15-runner field.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Honest Pace Suits Prominent
scenarios.trigger: If The Sweet Escape and Our Misty Blue establish a solid tempo without going too fast early
scenarios.body: The even gallop allows prominent runners to get into ideal positions and use their tactical speed when it matters. Horses like Gladiadora and Antiquity can sit handy and have less ground to make up than the hold-up brigade.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Favours Closers
scenarios.trigger: If the two front-runners go too hard in the early stages and compromise each other
scenarios.body: The strong early pace will set up a finish for horses coming from behind who have been saved for one run. Hold-up horses like Revich and Sir David can use their stamina to pick up the pieces as the pace-setters weaken.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If The Sweet Escape or Our Misty Blue gets an uncontested lead and dictates terms
scenarios.body: One of the pace-setters manages to slip the field and build an unassailable advantage, with their stamina reserves intact for the finish. The lack of early pressure allows them to control the race from pillar to post.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tactical Pace Benefits Mid-Division
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes messy with hesitant early fractions and bunching
scenarios.body: A stop-start tempo creates a cavalry charge finish where positioning matters more than running style. Horses that can adapt tactically and find gaps in traffic will have the edge over those committed to extreme styles.

watchPoints.text: Our Misty Blue tends to fade in the finish so if she sets too strong a pace early she could compromise her chance and any pace rival
The Sweet Escape and Our Misty Blue both want to lead so watch the early battle between them as it could set up the race for closers
Antiquity has Saffie Osborne aboard and comes from the Jamie Osborne yard but has been expensive to follow on good ground
Several horses return from long absences including Sir David (191 days) and Future Cutlet (175 days) so market support will be telling
Watch for any market moves on Gladiadora who gets 5lbs from claiming rider Liam Wright and won well at Southwell last time

runners_data.name: Gloriola
runners_data.note: Prominent racer stepping up in trip after 183-day absence, significant weight relief through OR drop

races.paceDynamic: Light The Night Up will lead unopposed early with five prominent racers (Venetian Romance, Kokushoku, Aneirin's Sword, Smartanck, Gloriola) creating congestion behind. This pack will apply sustainable pressure to the leader while the six hold-up horses (Bearin Up, Kokoluna, Del Corso, Saint Of The Sea, Bird Of War, Crimson Rambler) track from mid-division. The prominent group will create traffic problems turning for home as they fan out for racing room. This scenario clearly favours hold-up horses who can pick their way through and finish strongly from the back.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Heroes Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent congestion creates the expected traffic jam 2-3 furlongs out
scenarios.body: The six hold-up horses will have clear runs while the prominent pack gets squeezed for room. Late finishing power will prevail over those caught in early scrimmaging.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pack Breakaway
scenarios.trigger: If 2-3 prominent horses detach from the main group approaching the turn
scenarios.body: They'll get first run on Light The Night Up and have enough gap to hold off late challengers. Racing room becomes less critical with early separation.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Sustained Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Light The Night Up sets too strong an early gallop and the field comes back to him late
scenarios.body: The pace will fall apart in the final furlong allowing any horse with stamina reserves to pick up the pieces. Distance specialists will benefit most.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front Runner Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Light The Night Up gets easy early fractions and kicks again
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace pressure will leave him with too much energy for the finish. The prominent horses will be too far back to respond.

watchPoints.text: Light The Night Up getting uncontested early fractions could make him very hard to peg back despite his layoff
Traffic problems developing 2f out as five prominent horses and six hold-up types converge simultaneously
Venetian Romance and Bearin Up both returning from 175+ day breaks in competitive handicap
Aneirin's Sword and Smartanck both racing prominently off recent good form could press the pace early
Bird Of War and Crimson Rambler as the best-handicapped hold-up horses if getting clear runs

runners_data.name: Secret Beach
runners_data.note: Class hold-up performer returning from jumping, last flat win at Newmarket shows ability when right
runners_data.comment: Struggled on hurdling/stable debut in December but his last Flat run resulted in a win
runners_data.spotlight: Struggled on hurdling/stable at Newbury in December but his last Flat run resulted in a brave win at Newmarket (1m4f, good) in the autumn; still looks feasibly treated on that form and he's in the mix back from another break; had a second wind operation since his last run.

runners_data.name: Jez Bomb
runners_data.note: Consistent hold-up horse from same stable as Kind Of Kiss, proven winner but needs gaps to appear
runners_data.comment: Generally reliable type and things didn't go his way on Tapeta latest; dangerous
runners_data.spotlight: Had four wins in 2024 and another four last April-October; none of those were above Class 5 but he's been placed in some Class 4 events since November and things didn't go his way at Wolverhampton last time; should get a better tow into this race and he's in the mix back on turf.

runners_data.name: Mighty Quiet
runners_data.note: Prominent style but 160-day absence and weak trainer form make him vulnerable despite low weight

races.paceDynamic: Just An Hour will set the pace as the sole confirmed front runner, likely getting an uncontested lead at a sustainable tempo over this staying trip. Moon Beginnings, Monty Beau, Love Beach, Qitaal and Mighty Quiet all want prominent positions behind the leader, creating significant congestion and potential trouble in running 2-3 furlongs out when the pace quickens. The hold-up horses Cavolo Nero, Kind Of Kiss, Secret Beach and Jez Bomb will be relying on gaps appearing in the straight. This race shape strongly favours the front runner and early prominent horses who can secure clear racing room, as the bunched field behind will create traffic problems for late runners.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Just An Hour gets soft fractions and kicks clear turning for home
scenarios.body: The 166-day break won't matter if he gets an easy lead, and his proven stamina at this trip gives him every chance to stay clear of the pack. The prominent horses will be too busy fighting each other to mount a serious challenge.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Traffic Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the five prominent runners bunch up and interfere with each other 2f out
scenarios.body: This creates the perfect storm for a patient hold-up horse like Cavolo Nero or Secret Beach to pick up the pieces with a clear run. The pace will collapse as the leaders get in each other's way.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Early Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Just An Hour goes too slow early and gets swamped by the prominent brigade
scenarios.body: Moon Beginnings and Love Beach have the class to capitalize when multiple horses hit the front together. The hold-up horses won't get enough pace to run at.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Late Surge Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is genuinely strong and the field spreads out naturally
scenarios.body: Secret Beach's Newmarket win shows he has the class to pick up a strong pace, while Jez Bomb's multiple wins prove his finishing kick. Both need the race to unfold without interference.

watchPoints.text: Moon Beginnings and Love Beach could get squeezed out when the prominent pack converges 2f out
Just An Hour's 166-day layoff might tell in the final furlong if pressed hard by fresher rivals
Cavolo Nero needs to be positioned close enough to strike as hold-up horses could get too far back
The five prominent runners bunching together will create interference - watch for trouble in running
Secret Beach's jumping preparation might have left him short of flat race sharpness despite his class
